== Notes ==
* Hyl Thunderwing has six possible spawn points in Mineral Springs, which he shares with five other Avicara [[boss]]es: [[Ryk Arrowwing]], [[Myd Springclaw]], [[Nhy Darkclaw]], [[Syr Honorcrest]], and [[Wyt Sharpfeather]]. This doesn't apply while the quest [[Defend Droknar's Forge]] is active. Instead, he and all the Avicara bosses have a fixed location.
